summary: Bug fix verified end-to-end: adding avatar_file_id to the Player Pydantic response_model in backend/models.py fixes the roster photo preview. Backend pytest (6/6 PASS): GET /api/players now returns avatar_file_id on every player (null when unset, file_id string when set); the full upload chain POST /api/files/init -> /chunk -> /finalize -> PATCH /api/players/josh-ankermann/contact {avatar_file_id} persists the file_id, and the subsequent GET /api/players reflects it; /api/files/{id}/raw returns the correct image bytes; josh-ankermann password login regression PASS. Frontend playwright (mobile viewport 375x812) confirms: after uploading a photo via the backend chain, the Kader row testID=kader-row-josh-ankermann renders exactly one whose src = https://.../api/files/F9a6b20d4112e40/raw (the /api/files/ prefix requirement is met), the position-letter fallback text 'RM/RA' is not rendered inside the avatar circle when a photo is set, and after page.reload() the same re-appears with the identical src, proving the value round-trips through the DB and the newly-fixed Pydantic response_model. Screenshot shows the red uploaded PNG rendered in the round avatar slot for Josh. No regressions in login flow or Kader navigation.
